Establishes and maintains standards of care, utilizing the nursing process; provides and demonstrates quality nursing care by initiating individualized care plans, problem solving, utilization of hospital and community resources, and collaboration with other health professionals.
Evaluates, plans, develops and coordinates Dendrion patient care, pheresis patient care and intrathecal patient care in line with best evidence in each area.

Evaluates, plans, develops and implements the quality of care throught such activities as staff and environmental rounding, audits for the purpose of identifying problems which are common to nursing, planning and adminstering staff and patient education when needed, policy review, writing and updating, assuring that EMR and drug regimens are up to date and in line with best evidence,
Assists with the development, communication, and implementation of established standards, policies, procedures and protocols. Offers regular feedback, guidance and support to staff.
